content.text: This repository is a publication server containing a growing number of research publications. With this publication server, WIAS supports its scientists in their efforts to publish open access.

metadataPolicy.text: All bibliographic metadata provided via this interface, except abstracts, is hereby made available under CC0 license, free to share and re-use.

dataPolicy.text: The publications and electronic documents provided here must be used according to copyright laws, all rights reserved if not otherwise explicitly specified.

submissionPolicy.text: All publications like preprints, reports, teaching material, research data, software, etc. be it primary or secondary publications can be stored on the server. Moreover, it is possible to enter bibliographic data without full text in order to create publication lists.

eprints.comment: This institutional repository is powered by the MyCoRe repository software, see https://www.mycore.org/ for more information.
